comparison: Frozen simple / past3 level / past3 unconditional trend / history-gated trend-level. Same-count and same-CR controls, direct gated-vs-level matching and same-FA budget are GT offline diagnostics only.
cutoff: Only q gate fitted once on complete TRAIN. Eligible: current correct, simple accepted, three past outputs all size-correct. Maximum group95 whole-tie q cutoff. Both rejection cutoffs frozen.
gate: full-frame raw correct retention95 by domain/video; same-count and same-CR strict overall gain vs simple/score, per-group nonincrease, longest correct FR protection; evidence-only, no adoption; improve over level at matched CR or exact FA, correct-FR continuity protection vs old at matched CR; if failed stop this three-observation gate rule, no window/threshold search or TEST
limitations: Sample indices do not imply original consecutive frames or wall-clock seconds.
No physical motion model; genuine motion can trigger deviation.
Stable incorrect sizes can remain low-risk.
Unsupported history preserves original flags; no frames omitted from full evaluation.
VAL already exposed; no feature/window/threshold reselection after report.
With three equally spaced points the formula equals endpoint secant extrapolation; middle point cancels and no outlier robustness is established.
TRAIN seq05/seq06 have no original-simple-accepted correct support; group95 fitting does not protect all TRAIN correct outputs.
Old-rule matched CR/FA cutoffs use GT offline, never stored as an online policy.
History linearity is not history correctness; stable errors can pass the gate.
Matched curve diagnostics scale normalized residual cutoffs with branch choices frozen; they are not new online policies.

scope: complete saved TRAIN -> fixed evidence and threshold -> complete VAL; no new inference, learned head or TEST
